fields.statement: At 628be46, go test ./internal/tui/roadmapapp -run Tick -v -count=1 passes TestTickReloadsOnlyTheRunSectionOfAnOpenDetail (opens the detail with a fake run.status in state running, switches it to succeeded, sends TickMsg, sees 'state succeeded' in the view, change.show count unchanged, tick re-arms) and TestTickInListCallsNoRunStatus (TickMsg in the list view makes zero run.status calls). Diff read: Init arms a 3s tea.Tick (Interval = 3*time.Second); TickMsg calls reloadRun, which returns early when m.detail is nil or errored and otherwise replaces only detail.run via latestRun (run.status). gofmt -l is clean, go vet and go test ./... pass; make check's self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor/index files for this run's actors, unrelated to the leaf.
